releaseName: See what a run did, and the Free plan on record
summary: Run details has a folded Steps section: each model call of a run with its round, model, duration and estimated cost, and the error type of a failed call (#2693). It reads the run's content-free trace, which people can also read over the API (#2691). The plan catalog records the approved pricing ladder: a Free plan with one welcome application on the standard pair and 20 model calls a day outside runs, credit packs of 1 for 5 euros and 5 for 22 euros valid 12 months, and Individual at 5 applications a month (#2679). A run that used retrieval because its evidence passed the workspace cost cap now says so, instead of reading like evidence too large for the models (#2696). On French screens, the run summary, the independence labels and the writing policy lineage are translated (#2698).
knownLimitations: The Steps section appears only for runs the server executed since traces were recorded, and the local-first desktop has none. Buying a credit pack and self-service sign-up are not built: an operator still assigns plans and grants credits, and whether prices include VAT is open (#2677). Above the cost cap a run still gets the standard retrieval; picking evidence per job requirement is planned (#2667). Guides have not been walked with a paid run yet (#2623). Holding back a fact withholds the whole source passage it was quoted from. The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). On the hosted staging service, drafting needs model screening, which stays off there until Claude on Vertex AI is available. Assistant sign-in needs an identity provider, which staging does not have yet. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs.
